acceptanceCriteria: Resolved with a regression test using a committed Latin-1 path, or closed by an owner decision that the current behavior stands.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 as a gap left open by decision 0394, which accepted IDX-SNAP-V0-024 (panel blocker B9, PR #219): a tracked path whose Git bytes are not UTF-8 is an index exclusion, not a repository refusal. affected and prove on a dirty worktree still refuse when Git status reports a non-UTF-8 path, because internal/liveverify/affected/dirty.go decodes status on its own and was not changed. The contextindex parseStatus fix (display form, still counted dirty) is the model. Falsifier: a repository with one committed Latin-1 path, modified in the worktree, where affected or prove refuses instead of disclosing it.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0314: commit f02588a6; AC1: affected/dirty.go:203 converts invalid path bytes to display form; TestDirtyNonUTF8PathIsDisclosedNotRefused commits a Latin-1 path and verifies dirty/range disclosure. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch C) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: B9 gap: affected and prove refuse a dirty tree that has a non-UTF-8 path
